item.title: Advice vs. Advise – What’s the Difference?
item.description: Advice and advise look and sound similar, but they have different meanings and grammar roles. Advice is a noun, while advise is a verb. Many English learners confuse these words because they seem related but are used differently. In this article, you’ll learn the difference between advice and advise, with clear definitions, usage rules, and examples to help you understand each word correctly.
